entries.text: "To think you're still\nin a place like that!"
"The People should just live\nin the Domepolis!"
"I'll impose order and punishment on you!"
"I too have been granted a\nGolem! I will master it!"
"As a Golem pilot, I can\ndo at least this much!"
"Fall back! I can still hold out longer!"
"I won't let things go your way!"
"Having to let that one get away...!"
"At this rate, that one will get away!"
"That's what happens when\nyou let your guard down!"
"What's wrong? Is aiming\nall you can manage!?"
"The gap between the center and\nthe frontier just showed itself."
"So you resist after all! That only\nmakes your crimes more serious!"
"To think there's such\nskill out in the sticks...!"
"They're that strong?!\nThat's not what was said!"
"Damn! Our equipment\ncan't stand up to this!"
"H-hearing about it and seeing it\nare two very different things...!"
"W-we're Saint Regan!\nSo how can this be!?"
"What's one more crime at this point!"
"This is the end for all of you!"
"Like I'd let you have your way!"
"I-I have to fight that one all alone...!?"
"No way an attack like that will hit me!"
"Whew...\nIt hit a thick section of armor."
"To think the damage\nwould be this bad...!"
"Damn it!\nBoss will chew me out again for this!"
"The likes of you are below me!"
"You can't possibly beat Abyss\nin the water!"
"Still hanging on? Hurry up and disappear!"
"Now then, how many can I shoot down?"
"Where are you looking, hey?!\nThis isn't over yet!"
"Damn it...! Make sure you\ntake the target down!"
"All right, it's nearly\ntime for the climax!"
"Huh? Am I actually in\npretty deep trouble...?"
"Quit hiding and come out, you bastard!"
"Think you can hit me with that?\nDon't make me laugh!"
"No, no! You're no good at this!"
"You think you can kill me with that?!\nDon't underestimate me! You hear?!"
"What a racket! What the hell is that?!"
"Is that all you've got, new model?!"
"Oh, what a relief!\nGood thing that wasn't the stolen one!"
"If you keep holding back, you'll... die."
"Whew, you got me there.\nThat really took me by surprise!"
"You've got some skill! I\nhave a new respect for you!"
"As expected of Abyss's sister unit!\nLooks like it has decent specs!"
"What the hell is this?!\nI seriously don't get it!"
"A-any more of this and\nI'm in serious trouble...!"
"Owww...! Why do I have\nto go through this?!"
"Damn it!\nNot to that one! I won't lose!"
"No way! Me, of all people, at\na mere Coordinator's hands...!"
"N-no way! Not me! This can't be!!"
"I don't want this... I... not like this..."
"Not yet!\nI don't want to die yeeet!!"
"There is no escape...\nfor you, or for me."
"What sort of path have you walked?"
"I'll set you free...\nfrom this abnormal world."
"What will be offered up, body or heart?"
"Is that power what I seek, or not...?"
"The power of creation\nis a heavy shackle..."
"Will you, too, walk the\nsame path as me...?"
"With those wings,\nhow far do you intend to fly?"
"A being that is not human seeks to\nknow the human heart. The answer is..."
"Now, how far can you keep\nyour fear under control?"
"Those who can forget everything\nare fortunate, in a way."
"Kei Katsuragi... Yours is a strange fate.\nIt may be like mine."
"So you chose the middle\npath between god and devil..."
"Wander through endless ages, and the\nstandards of good and evil reverse..."
"If that power grows,\nthen someday you will..."
"The human heart is a mosaic...\njust like this world."
"There can be no liberation of the soul."
"Go on and share it.\nThe suffering, and the sorrow..."
"Such keen senses make\nyou hurt one another..."
"Will the butterfly of destruction\nand rebirth awaken, or not...?"
"Grave sins cannot be atoned\nfor. Just as in my case..."
"The fighting never stops,\nand sorrow never ends."
"You yourselves are the seeds of\nconflict... Though that suits me well."
"Heh heh heh... How much pain\ncan your mind and body endure?"
"I won't let you escape.\nTo me, you are a precious sacrifice."
"I know you well.\nA past colored by sorrow... and despair."
"Heh heh heh... What shall I\ntake from you this time?"
"Little by little... Bit by bit... I'll take\naway the things that matter to you."
"Anger and sorrow lay\nyour true nature bare..."
"You can surely endure a\ngreat deal of pain, can't you?"
"Ziene... I'll give you\nthe finest agony, too."
"The precious orb grows brighter\nthrough human sorrow...!"
"Now, let me hear your roar of pain."
"The lion's teardrops open a new door..."
"The Edel... I'll give you\nthe ultimate pleasure."
"The hour of black hell...\nhas come for you!"
"The Demon King's blade... like a gale!"
"It's for you, and also for me."
"The wolf stands in front of the lion...!"
"Come at me as often as you like."
"What do you intend to take from me?"
"I'm not worthy to be your prey."
"Even a lion cannot catch a wolf."
"How many more must be killed\nbefore you get serious?"
"You're the sacrifice I have high\nhopes for. Don't disappoint me."
"You expect to take revenge like that?"
"I hope this drives you\nto despair once more."
"So... what do you intend to do next?"
"What will you create?\nWhat will you bring forth?"
"Is that still all the\npower you can muster...?"
"Do you intend to waste\nyour hidden power?"
"The blue of sorrow... a fine color."
"Black arbiter... can you\npass judgment on me?"
"Unless you wield a demon\ngod's power as a demon god..."
"Even if humans evolve,\nit means nothing if the world is broken."
"Paint it all black.\nHuman history... and the life I've led."
"I have seen it. With these eyes,\nthe history of humanity's wars..."
"As long as humans are human,\nthey cannot abandon conflict."
"Hmph... is there still not enough pain?"
"Is more sorrow needed\nto draw out that power...?"
"Enjoy yourself, The\nEdel. While you still can."
"You seem to possess a\nfair measure of power."
"It seems a little of the outer\narmor was stripped away."
"Shurouga seems to be\ngetting in the mood."
"Hehehe... I'm glad to\nhave met prey like you."
"A mechanical god... Can it\ncorrect the distortion?"
"White stranger... What will\nthat power bring forth?"
"Is that power interfering\nwith me as well...?"
"Light and darkness... The\ntwo seem to coexist."
"I can sense your\nimpatience... What about you?"
"As long as humans remain human,\ntrue innovation will never come...!"
"To me, you are the finest sacrifice..."
"Feed on sorrow and burn away your life.\nThen... Hehehe."
"The Edel... I will never be yours."
"This pain... Hehehe, it's been so long...!"
"What do you think, Shurouga?\nImpressive, isn't it?"
"Yes, that's right.\nShow me you can make me suffer...!"
"I will not fall. For I have already..."
"Shall we fall into the abyss together...?"
"H-hehehe...\nThe more gods to sacrifice, the better...!"
"Is there light in the human heart?\nCan it save the world...!?"
"Hehehe, if I inflict even\ngreater pain on you..."
"Surrender to intense emotion...\nThen unleash your power...!"
"Shurouga... Embrace the darkness\nand shatter the light...!"
"Crave sinful souls! Devour them! Then\nconsume even your own soul completely!!"
"Hehehe... Falling feels\ngood once you try it."
"The gates of Infinite Hell open now...!"
"My past! My sins! My destiny!\nAnd my despair!!"
"Heh... I wonder where my hope lies."
"I'll get rid of anyone in my way!"
"Since you're resisting, you must\nbe prepared for the consequences!"
"Two options!\nSurrender quietly or be shot down!"
"You already have one\nfoot in the coffin!"
"In Saint Regan's name, I'll punish you!"
"Whatever happens, I'm still Saint Regan!\nYou'll learn what I'm truly capable of!!"
"I stand here with my pride on the line!"
"Ready to make Siberia\nmy final resting place!"
"I've obtained it!\nAt last, the ultimate power is mine!!"
"You're full of openings! One more blow!"
"Where are you looking?! I'm right here!"
"Don't think you can\nmatch Golem in strength!!"
"Phew... That bastard\nreally got on my nerves..."
"I'll show you how to use the Dominator!"
"But it's almost time for your last look!!"
"With the Overdevil under my command,\nI have no equal!!"
"If this is an act of Overdevil,\nbringer of the dark midnight sun...!!"
"If the Icing Gate can be opened,\nfeats like this should be possible toooo!!"
"Next, I'll show you an attack in\nthe style of the central region!"
"In keeping with city etiquette,\nallow me to return the favor!"
"It's too soon to relax.\nI'm not that soft!"
"Don't think I'll let you\nkeep having your way!"
"Reckless attacks like that\nare why backup is needed!"
"My thanks for that fine attack,\nesteemed wildflower of Siberia!"
"Even a band of amateurs managed\nto at least provide a distraction...!"
"Pathetic, Gain! I'll take over from here!"
"It's been a while since we\nfought in sync like this, Gain!"
"What are you doing?! Get back, now!"
"I'm utterly appalled, Zakki!\nTo be so careless!"
"You bumpkin! Making me look after you!"
"You owe me one for this, Gain!"
"I'll take down at least\none unit for certain!"
"I'll give the orders! All\nunits, coordinate your timing!"
"In range! Let's crush them in one go!"
"Very well! I'll go along with that plan!"
"I won't let even a single unit escape!!"
"Black Southern Cross...! Long-range\nshooting is your specialty, is it?!"
"Gain Bijou!\nIs running away all you aspire to?!"
"You think that caught me off guard?!"
"How do you expect to land a hit?!"
"You Yapan lot, obey us\nwithout a fuss, too!"
"If I use the Dominator's\nOverskill to its fullest...!"
"What do you think a shield is for?!"
"This can't be dismissed as a joke!"
"So Oversense frays the nerves...\nis that it?!"
"You'd rebel with that level of power?!"
"Hmph! The guards struggled\nwith such a weak Overman?"
"Hahahaha! It's so cooozy\ninside these ice ramparts!"
"You make me laugh!\nHow could that stop the Black History?!"
"Gah! That performance\nis of great interest to our side!"
"Guh! You barbarian, worse than\na sluggish shaggy elephant!"
"Damn you, Yapan!\nEvery last thing you do is infuriating!"
"Megalopolis woman!\nAre you saying I lack skill?!"
"Are you saying I haven't\nmastered the Dominator?!"
"Give it up, give it up! Nothing you\ndo now will help against Overfreeze!"
"Gah!! But the word defeat\nsimply doesn't suit me...!"
"Damn it!! Where did I go wrong!?"
"Guuuh! Not yet!\nI won't let it end yet!!"
"W-what is this...?!\nSomething... is something still missing...?!"
"You're with the Overdevil after all... If\nthe legends are true, that's terrifying~!"
"Not yet!\nNot until I take you back to the center!!"
"Not yet! As long as I live,\nI won't allow any Exodus!!"
"Guh! The Siberian Railway developed\nan Overman like this on its own?!"
"Without this Dominator,\nI'd have been reduced to wreckage...!"
"Overman of Yapan!\nIf you're kin to the Overdevil, obey me!!"
"There are ways to fight\neven a huge opponent!"
"Outsiders! I won't let you\ndo as you please in Siberia!"
"I won't let outsiders\nthrow their weight around in Siberia!!"
"Gym Ghingnham's spring?!\nThere's no way I'll accept that!!"
"You have the devil's energy\ntoo, don't you?!"
"Gain, damn you!\nFor my younger sister Karin!!"
"Silhouette Machines are\nno match for me anymore!"
"It's because you people of Yapan\ngo on an Exodus!!"
"Mechanical Angel! The Overdevil\nsays it wants to fight you!"
"You think you can beat me\nwith an Overman like that?!"
"Megadeus with the name Big!\nCome to me as well!"
"To think a mere breaker\nwould come this far!"
"Let's see what that so-called\nWalker Machine can do!"
"That violates Article 9 of the Citizens'\nCharter, also called the Exodus Law!"
"That hulking body...\nI'll sink it with one blow!"
"Even a silver Overman,\nonce it faces me...!"
"A mere Silhouette Machine!\nI'll fell it in one blow!"
"Gain! To bring divine punishment down on\nyou, I'd even sell my soul to the devil!"
"Gain! So what if you've got\na new Overman?!"
"Just the Siberian Railway!\nYou're no match for Golem!"
"I won't let you do as you please!"
"There must be something I can do too!"
"If there's a future beyond this battle!"
"I should still be able to keep going!"
"I'll take you down in one blow!"
"With this machine, I'll uphold\nthe justice I believe in!"
"I'll fight...\nFor all people and the world's future...!"
"Both people and the world\nhold infinite possibilities...!"
"I'll strike down whatever\ngives rise to war!"
"I won't let the world\nbe shrouded in darkness!"
"Don't exchange fire driven\nonly by anger and hate!"
"Do you all want the world to be\nnothing but war again?!"
"Captain La Flaga, leave the rest to me!"
"Captain La Flaga, I'll take it from here!"
"You're just the same as ever, Yzak."
"You're overextending yourself,\nShinn! What are you doing?!"
"Fall back, Rey! Leave this to me!"
"I won't let you take down the Minerva!"
"Orders received! I'll keep them in check!"
"Looks like there's no\nchoice but to fall back...!"
"If I stand still, I'll be a target...!"
"You think I'd fall for that trick?!"
"If I'm taken out, I won't even\nbe able to do what I can now...!"
"Why can things only be\nsettled through fighting?!"
"Meyrin's on board too...\nI can't afford to go down!"
"Don't you realize you're\nbeing manipulated yet, Shinn?!"
"Don't go into battle while\nyou're wavering, Lunamaria!"
"Fall back! I don't want to fight you!"
"Captain Gladys!\nIf you insist on fighting, then I...!"
"All this fighting wasn't\nto serve your own interests!"
"I can't let myself be taken down\nuntil I've stopped you!"
"Is the Second Stage's power\nnot being drawn out...?"
"Gah! Are you trying\nto stop my movement?!"
"If you lack the strength, fall\nback! Do you want to die?!"
"Rey! You can't defeat me\nwith determination alone!"
"Kira, stop!\nWhy are you and I fighting?!"
"Stop, Shinn!\nAt least let me get Meyrin out!"
"Think carefully, Shinn! Is that\nreally the kind of power you wanted?!"
"Stop, Rey! Don't just do\nwhatever the Chairman says!"
"Stop, Lunamaria! There should\nbe no reason for us to fight...!"
"Chairman! Is this how you'll eliminate\nall who don't conform to your wishes?!"
"I won't let you do as you\nplease with my destiny!"
"Why don't you understand, Kira?!\nWith methods like that...!"
"Fast! Is that the power\nof the Second Stage?!"
"That power... So that's\nwhat a new model can do!"
"I can still move...! I can still fight!"
"Gah! So only a different\napproach will work...!"
"I can still keep the machine balanced!"
"Tch!\nI can't die in a place like this!"
"I can't give up...!\nNot until I've stopped you all!"
"The Destiny, fully mastered...?!\nWith a heart full of hatred...!"
"Gah! Where does that\npower of Rey's come from?!"
"That way of fighting... It's just like...!"
"That strength...\nIt isn't just the Impulse's performance...!"
"Not yet! Until I stop you, I...!"
"Chairman! I'm putting my own life\non the line in this battle too!"
"Damn!\nAt this rate, it'll be like that time...!"
"Even if it's a new model,\nto be overwhelmed this badly...!"
"Are you all just like Kira too?!"
"What do you know?!\nWhat are you fighting for?!"
"Asakim Dowen!\nWhat are you plotting in the shadows?!"
"Edel Bernal! With my own hands,\nI'll avenge those who trusted you!"
"I'll strike you down\nand bring light back to our world!"
"I can't let you all\ndo as you please...!"
"Kira! Empty platitudes, as if you're\nthe only one who understands!"
"I won't accept a world\ndriven by your ego!"
"Scirocco! We have no intention of\ndancing in the palm of your hand!"
"Don't let fleeting emotions\nsweep you away, Shinn!"
"Shinn! Don't let anger\ncontrol how you fight!"
"Stop fighting while you're still\ntrapped in the past! You too!"
"Shinn! Why don't you realize\nyou're just being manipulated?!"
"How far can I get against\nShinn and that new model...?!"
"I'll set your mistaken course right...\nJust as I was told back then...!"
"To think they're victims\nof the Destiny Plan...!"
"Captain Gladys...!\nThis is the answer I've reached...!"
"Rey!\nDo you know what the Chairman is after?!"
"Do personal feelings simply\nget crushed in war...?!"
"Understood! I'll leave the timing to you!"
"I don't intend to be killed like this!"
"I'm not dying in a place like this!"
"Damn it, in a place like this!"
"That's what you get for\nbutting in every time!"
"You're going to help me\nblow off some steam!"
"You insolent People and\nthe rest of you riffraff!"
"My body feels light! The diet paid off!"
"It's amazing Gainer\nmanaged to beat this thing."
"Who could forget a woman this fine...?"
"I'll put the tuition on your tab."
"There's an opening after an attack!\nThat's what you aim for!"
"Hey! As if I'd let you get away!"
"Trying to just run off like that?\nThat's far too convenient for you!"
"Look away and the next attack's coming!"
"Show some actual skill\ninstead of just talking!"
"Tch! That's what happens\nwhen you leave it to Jaboli!"
"With this supple, well-trained body,\nI can't lose to Sara!"
"Teacher will show you how it's done!"
"Why are you just standing\nthere, spaced out?!"
"What are you doing?!\nDon't let your guard down!"
"I won't let Captain Yassaba\nget taken down!"
"Wasn't running away\nthe one thing you were good at?!"
"Sara, you owe me one for this."
"Gauli!\nI won't let you be taken down!"
"Jaboli! Do a little better than that!"
"No time to waste! Let's get moving!"
"I know, I know! Leave it to me!"
"No usable weapons...!\nShould I steal some from somewhere...?!"
"This much is a piece of cake!"
"Hahaha! You've got a real\nknack for making people laugh!"
"Now that I've warmed up,\nI can dodge better than usual!"
"Watch the moves closely\nand you can read them!"
"I'm not as slow as a shaggy\nelephant, you know. ...Heh."
"This red paint isn't just for show!"
"Hmph... The Siberian Railway's\nstandards sure have fallen..."
"Looks like it's not just your character\nthat's crooked, but your aim too!"
"Wars aren't fought in conference rooms,\nyou spoiled rich brat!"
"With even your glasses frozen over,\nyou can't see what's right there, Gainer!"
"Didn't feel a hit, did\nyou? That was an illusion!"
"Holding back? I'm so\ngrateful I could cry."
"Now that's a trick only\nan Overman can pull off!"
"Ugh! My shield's getting dented all over!"
"Got to know how to use the\noptional gear properly, at least!"
"If I take a hit head-on,\nKona will chew me out!"
"No problem!\nThat one's nothing special at all!"
"I said, don't get smart with me!"
"Jeez...\nSo much noise from a lousy peashooter!"
"That's all you've got?!\nYou make me laugh!"
"Too bad for you.\nI'm only interested in strong men!"
"You think that level of power is enough\nto defy the Siberian Railway Guard?!"
"Just landing a hit only gets you a yuko!\nThat's no ippon!"
"Kejinan... Looks like only a painful\nlesson will get through to you...!"
"Take off that eyepatch you\nwear for show, then try again!"
"You're not following any of my teachings!\nJaboli!"
"Nasty...! Just the sort of attack I'd\nexpect from the Operations Director!"
"You're not putting your\nhips into it, Gainer!"
"Aaah!\n...Tch, what a pathetic noise I made!"
"Gwah! What are you going\nto do about my good looks?!"
"Whoa! Just what kind\nof opponent is this?!"
"Looks like the Siberian Railway\nstill has someone with some backbone...!"
"Damn it!\nKejinan gets carried away so easily!"
"This has to be Enge's handiwork!\nDamn, how sneaky!"
"You fawn on each new commander at once!\nDon't get cocky, woman!"
"Tch! I can just picture that\nsmirking face in the cockpit...!"
"Well, you do live up to\nSaint Regan's reputation!"
"Tch!\nCan't you fight with a little more class?!"
"Tch, what a sorry sight!\nTo think I'm being cornered!"
"Daaamn it!\nI won't let you do any more damage!"
"Damn it!!\nIf only I were piloting an Overman...!"
"Nuuugh! I'll put you on\nthe blacklist, you bastard!"
"The brats will laugh\nat me at this rate...!"
"Ganging up for a beating?!\nThat's just like you lot...!"
"Gah! Was it a mistake to let my guard\ndown just because it was Jaboli?!"
"A merciless attack...!\nJust like Kashmir Valle, damn it!"
"Typical city upbringing...!\nNot a shred of human kindness...!"
"Damn it, is that startup interference?!\nYou monster...!!"
"Gainer's ice...\nNot even my charms are any use...?!"
"I'll let you off this\ntime! You'll pay for this!"
"Once I beat you, class\nis back in session!"
"If you want to do as you please,\ndo it in the afterlife!"
"Enge! Hiding behind Kejinan\nwon't do you any good!"
"That turd of a director cares nothing\nfor staff lives! Time for punishment!"
"I'm telling you, you're not getting away,\nGainer Sanga!"
"Kejinan, is it?! Just the\nthing for making some money!"
"A Siberian Railway with no strong men?\nNo thanks!"
"Nihihi...! If Jaboli's my\nopponent, this'll be an easy win!"
"You're supposed to be\na strong man, Gauli!"
"I don't remember raising you to\nbe such a pathetic man! Gainer!"
"I know how things work\naround here! Get ready!"
"Even against you, I\nwon't show any mercy!"
"I'll show you a way of fighting\nonly an adult can manage!"
"Out of ammo when things\nare this much fun?!"
"A fine man, no doubt, but an\nenemy right now! I won't hold back!"
"I'm a Chiram soldier...!\nI'll defeat the enemy!"
"On my pride as a Chiram soldier!"
"This isn't about Chiram or Emaan...!\nFor this world!"
"Now, I'm fighting\nfor what I believe in!"
"Battle Form's arms\ncan be used this way too!"
"You let your guard down, thinking\nI couldn't fight up close!"
"Did you think you could\ndisengage so easily?!"
"I have no intention of\nletting you escape...!"
"Do you think I'd let you escape?!"
"Enemy craft confirmed down!\nMoving to the next target!"
"Enemy craft down. Not a\ntrace left, as expected..."
"This is why I took your bait...!"
"Letting your guard down\nafter attacking is fatal...!"
"I have no taste for\nbeing chased by you...!"
"You don't even realize\nyou've been lured in!"
"Don't pursue too far!\nStay back and watch!"
"I have no intention of\neasing up on the attack...!"
"I hate to admit it,\nbut that's good teamwork...!"
"I can't let an ally be shot down...!"
"Unnecessary losses must\nbe kept to a minimum...!"
"You shallow man... That's what you\nget for charging in carelessly...!"
"I won't let my one and only father\nbe taken down!"
"A charge by all units! Are you ready?!"
"Teamwork...? Can you keep up with me?"
"The attack continues until the\nenemy machine falls silent!"
"I can't put any more strain\non the generator...!"
"It seems you're using\nyour head a little."
"What a blunder...! Losing\nsight of the target...!"
"No hits taken... What a dull opponent."
"Don't think firing is\nenough to score a hit!"
"There's no point in aiming at me!"
"Even the Singularity doesn't\nseem to live up to the rumors!"
"I won't let your attacks hit me,\nif sheer stubbornness is what it takes!"
"In the end, you're just\na bunch of merchants..."
"With that huge body, you\ncan't keep up with me!"
"You certainly have power.\nAnd nothing but power..."
"Is something wrong with the Nikick...?\nTo think I'd get hit...!"
"I got hit... but that seems to be all..."
"Holding back? I won't tolerate being\ninsulted just because I'm a woman!"
"I see. Then I'll make\nyou my next target!"
"If that's all the skill you have, fall\nback! There's no point in fighting!"
"A man who spent his time womanizing\ncould never land a direct hit on me!"
"That's the best a merchant\nship's self-defense force can do."
"A mobile suit can't\nkeep up with my maneuvers!"
"Tch!\nA direct hit would take me out?!"
"For something so huge,\nyou can make precise movements too."
"I was prepared for this much\ndanger from the start...!"
"Seems you're quite good...!\nHehehe, this is getting fun...!"
"So I relied too much\non the Nikick's maneuverability...!"
"Not yet! If this much brings me down,\nUncle will laugh at me!"
"As expected of the Singularity...!\nIt seems it was worth coming out here!"
"How could I take a direct hit\nfrom a man like that?!"
"That was just like an accidental\ncollision! Don't get cocky, Emaan!"
"Ghhh! It's no use, I can't block it all?!"
"Tch...! If it's come to this, even if\nI have to sacrifice the machine...!"
"I have no choice but to admit it...\nThe enemy's skill surpasses mine...!"
"To read my moves this thoroughly...!\nWhat kind of opponent is this?!"
"Gah! Had a shootdown been intended,\nit should have been possible, and yet...!"
"Did I underestimate the enemy\ntoo much just for being Emaan...!"
"It's not the machine...\nIt's that pilot who's strong?!"
"I'll grant that it's an exceptional\nmachine! But it's not over yet!"
"Tch! If only we in Chiram\nhad that immense power...!"
"Gah! I-is this as far as I can go?!"
"In this world, mobile suits\nare just useless dead weight...!"
"My future with Uncle and Father...\nI won't let you destroy it!"
"I won't let you use this world\nto satisfy your filthy desires!"
"I never thought I'd end up fighting\na renowned machine from the past...!"
"A mere Factory House?\nI can handle it alone!"
"If the House is attacked,\nthe Singularity can't stand idly by...!"
"I won't let you do as you\nplease with Chiram, my homeland!"
"I'll make up for the\npower gap with speed!"
